module_summary: 10GBASE-R 64b/66b block decoder to AXI-Stream: classifies blocks into types, realigns lane-swapped starts, pipelines two stages, and a 3-state FSM frames packets with LFSR CRC check.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/LAST frame FSM driving tvalid, tkeep, tlast, CRC reset and errors

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: 64-bit encoded block payload; decoded for block type and masked into datapath

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream output data from m_axis_tdata_reg

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream valid asserted in PAYLOAD/LAST states

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header distinguishing data vs control blocks

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker set on terminate or error

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-valid mask derived from terminate block type

anchors.name: input_type_d0
anchors.why: Decoded block type (data/start/term/error) steering FSM transitions and tkeep

anchors.name: input_data_d0
anchors.why: First pipeline stage of aligned payload; fed to CRC LFSR

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running Ethernet CRC32 state, reset by FSM, updated from LFSR

anchors.name: lanes_swapped
anchors.why: Start on lane 4 detected; selects swapped data assembly and type remap

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting bad frame (CRC fail or control char in payload)

anchors.name: crc_valid
anchors.why: Per-byte-offset CRC residue match flags checked at terminate

anchors.name: crc_valid_save
anchors.why: Delayed CRC match flags used for late terminates

anchors.name: input_type_d1
anchors.why: Second-stage block type used for start detect and LAST tkeep

anchors.name: input_data_d1
anchors.why: Second-stage payload feeding m_axis_tdata_next

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data_masked
anchors.why: Input data with control bytes zeroed before staging

anchors.name: swap_data
anchors.why: Upper half of previous block used to realign swapped lanes

anchors.name: delay_type_valid
anchors.why: Selects delayed block type when lanes swapped; triggers start_packet

anchors.name: delay_type
anchors.why: Remapped block type for half-block-shifted lane alignment

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables packet start acceptance in IDLE state

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: User sideband: bad-frame bit plus optional PTP timestamp

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse reporting CRC/FCS mismatch

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet pulse indicating lane 0 or lane 4 start

anchors.name: rx_bad_block
anchors.why: Pulse on invalid block header or block type

anchors.name: ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Captured PTP timestamp at packet start for tuser

anchors.name: ts_inc_reg
anchors.why: Timestamp increment per cycle used for half-cycle start correction

anchors.name: ptp_ts
anchors.why: Incoming PTP time captured into ptp_ts_reg

groups.name: Frame FSM
groups.description: IDLE/PAYLOAD/LAST controller producing stream framing and error flags

groups.name: Block decoder and lane alignment
groups.description: Classifies 64b/66b block types and realigns lane-4 starts

groups.name: Input pipeline
groups.description: Two-stage data/type delay line feeding output and CRC

groups.name: CRC checker
groups.description: LFSR-based CRC32 accumulation with residue match per terminate offset

groups.name: Status flags
groups.description: Registered start, bad frame, bad FCS and bad block pulses

groups.name: PTP timestamp
groups.description: Captures and adjusts start-of-packet timestamp for tuser
